1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and __control means arranged to modulate air pressure in the brake chamber by controlling the first and second valves in response to wheel slip conditions__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __plural first valves and plural second valves arranged in a staged configuration__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, the larger and smaller valves being operatively distinct in their flow capacity and response characteristics__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein __the at least one smaller valve is arranged to operate at a higher response speed than the at least one larger valve__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein __the first and second valves are independently driven by binary actuators operating in response to control signals from the control means__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from __a wheel speed sensor, an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and a vehicle acceleration sensor__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and __to dynamically adjust braking force based thereon in real-time__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed __by selectively modulating the first and second valves to prevent wheel lock-up__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising __one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; a central compressed air storage tank; and a controller in communication with each air braking unit to coordinate braking force distribution across multiple wheels__.
